ETHEREUM.name: Aave v3 Ethereum
ETHEREUM.comment: Aave v3 core audited by OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, PeckShield, ABDK, SigmaPrime plus Certora formal verification, with every point release re-audited. Governance: onchain Aave Governance v3 with 1/7-day executor timelocks; Emergency Guardian (4-of-7) can pause but not upgrade. TVL $9.81B supplied (DefiLlama, 2026-07-02). Live on Ethereum since 2023-01-27. Solvency depends on Chainlink feeds via AaveOracle (scored under oracles.json/AaveOracle).

ARBITRUM_ONE.name: Aave v3 Arbitrum
ARBITRUM_ONE.comment: Same audited codebase and governance as Aave v3 Ethereum; non-Ethereum markets are administered via governance cross-chain executors. TVL $383M supplied (DefiLlama, 2026-07-02). Part of the original v3 launch on 2022-03-16.

BASE.name: Aave v3 Base
BASE.comment: Same audited codebase and governance as Aave v3 Ethereum. TVL $380M supplied (DefiLlama, 2026-07-02). Deployed on Base 2023-08-16 (Aave changelog).

OP_MAINNET.name: Aave v3 Optimism
OP_MAINNET.comment: Same audited codebase and governance as Aave v3 Ethereum. TVL $39.8M supplied (DefiLlama, 2026-07-02) - just below the $40M band, hence valueSecured 4. Part of the original v3 launch on 2022-03-16.

POLYGON_MAINNET.name: Aave v3 Polygon
POLYGON_MAINNET.comment: Same audited codebase and governance as Aave v3 Ethereum. TVL $108M supplied (DefiLlama, 2026-07-02). Part of the original v3 launch on 2022-03-16.

GNOSIS_CHAIN.name: Aave v3 Gnosis
GNOSIS_CHAIN.comment: Same audited codebase and governance as Aave v3 Ethereum. TVL $49.8M supplied (DefiLlama xDai figure, 2026-07-02). Market activated 2023-11-06 (governance proposal 357 / Aave changelog).
